changelog: v0.6.2: 1) WebXR 360 Floor Level & Horizon Alignment: 360 photo equirectangular sky domes centered at 1.6m eye height above physical local-floor, added real-time Avatar Height / Elevation Level Offset (Z/Y) slider and Quest 3 Touch Controller Grip+Stick shortcut; 2) Live Mode State Machine: strict acoustic echo isolation pauses mic during analyzing & speaking with 350ms cooldown before restoring listening, preventing feedback loops and confusion; 3) Multi-Core & DirectML GPU Acceleration: configured ONNX Runtime to use 20 CPU threads and DirectML GPU acceleration; 4) Server-Side Antigravity Agent Model: auto-detects host Antigravity installation/language server and exposes Google Antigravity Agent with deep agentic reasoning in Quest 3 model selection.
